hope_and_future: A better future is worth fighting for, even when success seems impossible.
People deserve the opportunity to choose their own future.
What we leave behind for future generations matters.
responsibility: Those who can help others should not abandon their responsibilities.
protection: Protecting others can be more important than personal happiness.
perseverance: Even when everything seems lost, one should keep moving forward.
sacrifice: Sacrifice may be necessary for a greater good.
relationships: Family is defined by love, loyalty, and commitment, not just blood.
